svg.title: STC-04 · Five slots on the page. Twenty loops on the reel.
svg.desc: Left: the five Stagehand web slots (S1 hero signature, S2 section transitions, S3 ambient layer, S4 data skin, S5 interaction and focus) with example fills from TX-01 VECTOR GRID. Right: a timeline of all twenty reel loops, beat by beat, colored by slot, with loop lengths from 21 to 26.3 seconds and every S4 data beat at 9.5 seconds.
svg.text: REF STC V1.0 / REEL V5 · FIG STC-04
Five slots on the page. Twenty loops on the reel.
Each reel beat demonstrates one web slot, so the reel doubles as a working slot map.
THE FIVE WEB SLOTS · FILLS FROM TX-01
A grid floor scrolls to the horizon while a light trail
Light trails link section points at right angles.
Horizon glow and 2% scanlines under everything.
Bars become light walls; lines leave a fading wake.
Neon focus rings with circuit-trace corners.
THE REEL · TWENTY LOOPS, BEAT BY BEAT
LOOPS RUN 21 TO 26.3 S · EVERY S4 RUNS 9.5 S · THE THIN STONE LINE IS S3, ALWAYS ON
BHIL · STAGEHAND THEME CODEX · FIG STC-04
